Write a polynomial-time reduction from Independent Set to Clique. problems.py defines both problems: SOURCE is Independent Set and TARGET is Clique. The SOURCE and TARGET class docstrings give the exact instance formats, yes-conditions and edge cases.

SOURCE = IndependentSet
Independent Set.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has an independent set of AT LEAST k vertices: k
vertices with no edge between any two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k > n is always no. With no edges,
every set of vertices is independent.

TARGET = Clique
Clique.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a clique of AT LEAST k vertices: k vertices with an
edge between every two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k = 1 is yes whenever n >= 1. k > n is
always no.

INPUT FILES: ["problems.py"]
WORKING DIRECTORY: /tmp/reduction-czi_xwzx

{"command":"cd /tmp/reduction-czi_xwzx && cat > reduce.py <<'EOF'
"""Polynomial-time reduction from Independent Set to Clique.

A vertex subset S is independent in G exactly when S is a clique in the
complement graph of G.  Therefore we map an Independent Set instance
(n, edges, k) to the Clique instance (n, complement_edges, k), where the
complement contains exactly the pairs {u, v} that are NOT edges of G.
"""

from itertools import combinations


def reduce(instance):
    """Return the Clique instance corresponding to an Independent Set instance.

    The graph is replaced by its complement; n and k are unchanged.
    """
    n = instance["n"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Normalise the given edges to frozensets so that [u, v] and [v, u]
    # are treated as the same edge, then build the complement.
    given = {frozenset((u, v)) for u, v in instance["edges"]}

    complement_edges = [
        [u, v]
        for u, v in combinations(range(n), 2)
        if frozenset((u, v)) not in given
    ]

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": k}
EOF

"""Polynomial-time reduction from Independent Set to Clique.

A vertex subset S is independent in G exactly when S is a clique in the
complement graph of G.  Therefore we map an Independent Set instance
(n, edges, k) to the Clique instance (n, complement_edges, k), where the
complement contains exactly the pairs {u, v} that are NOT edges of G.
"""

from itertools import combinations


def reduce(instance):
    """Return the Clique instance corresponding to an Independent Set instance.

    The graph is replaced by its complement; n and k are unchanged.
    """
    n = instance["n"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Normalise the given edges to frozensets so that [u, v] and [v, u]
    # are treated as the same edge, then build the complement.
    given = {frozenset((u, v)) for u, v in instance["edges"]}

    complement_edges = [
        [u, v]
        for u, v in combinations(range(n), 2)
        if frozenset((u, v)) not in given
    ]

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": k}
